title.zh: Anthropic 向警方报告日记内容，一名女性面临重罪指控
title.en: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge

current_state.zh:
Anthropic 标记了一名佛罗里达女性在 Claude 中当作日记撰写的条目，并向执法部门报告；该女性目前依据佛罗里达州法规 836.10 面临二级重罪指控，事由是威胁对一处警长办公室发动大规模枪击。据 Decrypt 和 Tom's Hardware 报道，该女性被确认为居住在博尼塔斯普林斯的“Carli”。

此案重新引发关于 AI 服务商是否应将用户私人对话交给当局的争论，也凸显出 Anthropic 的消费者条款保留了“完全自行决定”将用户的输入、输出或行为报告给执法部门的权利。据 Tom's Hardware 报道，这是自 8 月以来至少第三起被送抵警方的此类对话。

据 Decrypt 报道，Anthropic 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日生效的隐私政策允许在公司合理认为披露数据对防止严重伤害属必要时与警方共享数据。Tom's Hardware 指出，有关此案的更多细节预计将在 11 月的传讯之后公布。
current_state.en:
Anthropic flagged entries a Florida woman had written in Claude, which she was using as a diary, and reported them to law enforcement; she now faces a second-degree felony charge under Florida Statute 836.10 over a threatened mass shooting at a sheriff's office. The woman was identified as "Carli" of Bonita Springs, according to Decrypt and Tom's Hardware.

The case renews debate over whether AI providers should hand users' private conversations to authorities, and it highlights that Anthropic's consumer terms reserve the right, at the company's "sole discretion," to report a user's inputs, outputs or actions to law enforcement. Tom's Hardware reports it is at least the third such conversation to reach police since August.

Anthropic's privacy policy, effective September 10, 2026, permits sharing data with police when the company reasonably believes disclosure is necessary to prevent serious harm, according to Decrypt. Tom's Hardware notes that more details about the case should be available after an arraignment scheduled in November.

updates.background_zh: 佛罗里达州法规 836.10 规定，发送、发布或传输威胁杀害或伤害他人、实施大规模枪击或实施恐怖主义行为的书面或电子记录属二级重罪，且该通信须以他人可能看到的方式进行。Decrypt 指出，对被标记的对话，人工审核员可以将其当作“日记”来阅读。
updates.background_en: Florida Statute 836.10 makes it a second-degree felony to send, post or transmit a written or electronic record threatening to kill or injure someone, carry out a mass shooting or commit an act of terrorism, and the communication must be made in a manner in which another person may view it. Decrypt notes that a marked conversation can act as a "diary" to human reviewers.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者意见分化：有人对 Anthropic 表示理解，认为在 OpenAI 于类似案件中未报告枪手之后，该公司处于“不报也错、报也错”的处境，同时强调用户是在与大型科技公司对话，而非与私人知己交谈。另一些人认为该法条本意并非涵盖写给聊天机器人的日记内容，并质疑当威胁只是通过阅读用户条目才被发现时如何能据此起诉；还有几位评论者主张在本地运行开放权重模型，以避开服务商的监视。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters were split: one expressed sympathy for Anthropic, arguing it faces a "damned if you don't, damned if you do" situation after OpenAI failed to report a shooter in a similar case, while stressing that users are chatting with Big Tech rather than a private confidant. Others argued the statute was not intended to cover a chatbot diary entry and questioned how a threat can be charged when it was only obtained by reading the user's entries, and several urged running local, open-weight models to avoid provider surveillance.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此案对加密市场没有直接传导路径，但它通过情绪渠道强化了围绕隐私保护与去中心化 AI 基础设施的叙事，包括被宣传为集中式服务商替代方案的开放权重本地推理和去中心化算力网络，而非经由流动性或供给渠道产生影响。
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct transmission to crypto markets, but the case feeds the narrative around privacy-preserving and decentralized AI infrastructure — including open-weight local inference and decentralized compute networks marketed as alternatives to centralized providers — through the sentiment channel rather than through liquidity or supply.
